title: Castlevania: Bloodlines - Leaning Tower of Pisa (Interior)
description:
C3 2023 SUMMER SUBMISSION

The interior of the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa, from Castlevania: Bloodlines. A tilted background that is a good fit for wacky levels and castles, in general.

It was a freaking nightmare to loop this background, so I ask you to consider giving me some credit, if you are planning to use it.
